blockers.what_was_tried: Built the chain-replacement machinery from the Count clause up: the four readings of Count along a path, the rigid pending region (the countdown IS the distance to the region's end, so the first idle position sits at distance exactly cntAt g u + 1), the countdown rigidity under a fixed object walk, the 1-Lipschitz window on the next-deadline register with its dichotomy, and the collision reading of the class map. All 22 declarations compile with no sorry and no axiom. The type-transfer half was then attempted and is where it stops.
blockers.why_it_failed: A THIRD circularity, distinct from the two the agreement-first revision resolved. cntAt_eq_of_obj_eq forces the replacement to pump the OBJECT walk, and pumping preserves the realized type only through a MODEL-level periodicity statement about tpOf along a ladder path. The only landed periodicity statement is the eventual periodicity of prodPreStep (cohIdle) on Finset (ProdState Q phi), with outputs satThreshold/satPeriod -- a CERTIFICATE-relation fact, and CounterQuotient.lean states in source that nothing there relates cohIdle to Rlad, ladderModel, tpOf or cellAt. That bridge is exactly obligations (S) and (C'), Phases 12-15, which read this agreement. A model-level pumping lemma must be authored and no phase of plan 04 costs one.

blockers.why_it_failed: By stab_mem_tpOf_iff_cell the box-dot bit inside tpOf is a datum of the very cell the agreement compares, so the proof runs by induction on box-dot-nesting depth whatever the phase order is. Route (R-b) relocates the stratification into this phase's proof rather than removing it. At the model level the stratified objects are Finset PlusFormula values of tpOf, so (R-a)'s recorded cost -- a stratified certificate family beside Phase 9's layer -- does not transfer, but the task list contains no induction step.
